question: Do the same ten native Cano train meshes satisfy one coherent replay contract with exact generator inputs, bounded mesh discretization counts and bounded triangle-surface geometry?
reason: M0R3 passed S01-S06 and stopped at S07 solely because vertex counts were 156110/156109 (one vertex; 0.0006406%). Triangle counts differed by two and passed the existing 0.01% tolerance; point-to-surface, exact inputs/axis, both mesh audits, AABB and area also passed.

single_method_change.replacement: Require vertex-count relative difference abs(primary-replay)/max(primary,replay) <=0.0001 (0.01%), identical to the existing triangle-count tolerance.
retained: exact graph, spline, operation trace, effective parameters and axis
unchanged individual mesh quality, AABB <=0.5 m and surface-area difference <=1%
record counts, nearest-vertex statistics and OBJ hashes
single_method_change.threshold_basis: Use the already frozen 0.01% mesh-discretization tolerance consistently for both Poisson vertex and triangle counts. S07 train observation is 0.0006406%.

execution_policy: If approved, one new immutable run from scratch; no failed-run reuse, seed/parent change, repair, retry or validation/development-test inspection.
claim_boundary: M0R4 tests native perception-surface materialization stability only; PASS permits an M1 proposal but creates no data or navigation qualification.

estimated_cost.compute: Frozen E1 CPU; twenty native meshes and surface queries; no LiDAR, simulator or training.

approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after receiving the sealed M0R3 review and exact M0R4 unified-discretization proposal.
